convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for AroonSignal custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close positions), which requires manual reconstruction of both indicator logic and trading helper functions.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

other_exits: Historical bar scan for close signals: when both buy and sell open/close are permitted and no close signal on current bar, EA scans backward from SignalBar+1 through all bars looking for the most recent AroonSignal to generate a close signal (UpValue non-zero for SELL_Close, DnValue non-zero for BUY_Close)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = deposit fraction for deal sizing. Default MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed.

custom_logic_notes: The EA has a historical close-signal scan: if both buy and sell open+close permissions are enabled and no close signal was found on the current SignalBar, it loops backward through all bars looking for the most recent AroonSignal to generate a close signal. This means the EA can close positions based on signals from bars ago, not just the current bar. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans act as gates on both entry and exit. SignalBar=1 means the EA reads the indicator from the previous completed bar (index 1), not the current forming bar. The Recount mechanism retries on the next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: 1) AroonSignal custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Need to understand its internal calculation (Aroon Up/Down with HighLevel/LowLevel thresholds). 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be fully reconstructed - it contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar class. The MM parameter dual-behavior (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. 3) SL/TP are in points (not pips), so need _Point adjustment in Python. 4) The historical bar scan for close signals is unusual and must be carefully replicated. 5) SignalBar defaults to 1 (previous bar), so all signals are on completed bars - good for backtesting. 6) No digit adjustment logic present in this EA - SL/TP values are used as-is in points.
